checks.title: Entry-timing difference is declared
checks.detail: kernel enters at the hourly close; the live bot scans every 5 min on a forming candle, so the kernel reads pumps +0.54pp larger on average (188 matched setups). DECLARED LIMITATION: arena absolute WR is not live WR. Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel — but a promoted arm must still survive the earlier live entry, and that caveat is attached to every surfaced verdict.

findings.claim: 'measured ghost arrival = 25.6 control trades/day' is used as the arrival rate that makes the planned confirm n=600 reachable.
findings.problem: Nothing in the live tape supports 25.6 trades/day: events by tier show only 25 live events in total against 4764 backfill, and control's live_n is 4. A per-day rate derived from backfill replay is being presented as a measured live arrival rate, which makes every projection of time-to-n=600 unfounded.

findings.claim: paired_population is green — '4789 events in the shared window; every arm has seen all of them' — and arm-vs-arm screen numbers are compared directly.
findings.problem: Seeing an event is not scoring it. entry-8pct has screen_n=494 and vol-4x has screen_n=861 against control's screen_n=1541, so those arms are scored on strict subsets, not identical events. Comparing entry-8pct screen_wr=51.417 to control screen_wr=49.903 is an unpaired comparison on different populations, and the reported screen_dWR=0.0pp for both arms contradicts their own quoted win rates with no stated reconciliation.

findings.claim: All seven arms are reported as [running/confirm], with tp-7pct, hold-12h, entry-8pct, sl-5pct, vol-4x listed as 'live in the arena'.
findings.problem: Live sample sizes are live_n=4, 4, 1, 3, 2 against a confirm plan of n=600. entry-8pct is reported as a running confirm arm on a single live trade. Every ranking statistic quoted for these arms (screen_wr, screen_ev, screen_dWR) comes from the backfill screen, so 'running in confirm' describes registration status, not accumulated confirm evidence.

findings.claim: backfill_cannot_promote is green: 'Only live-tape evidence can promote — 0 surfaced arm(s); none promoted from a screen.'
findings.problem: The check passes vacuously. With zero arms surfaced there is nothing for the gate to have refused, so the observation establishes only that no promotion was attempted, not that the gate would block a backfill-driven promotion. A critical green here reads as a verified safeguard when it is an untested one.

findings.claim: no_lookahead is green and critical: 'detection is look-ahead free'.
findings.problem: The evidence is re-detection of 108 events across 6 coins, against a shared window of 4789 events across 176 coins. That is a spot check on a small fraction of events and coins; it cannot support an unqualified look-ahead-free verdict for the whole detection stream, especially given LA is the project's first-listed failure mode.

findings.claim: sl-5pct carries the arena's largest screen_dWR at 5.26pp and is treated as the leading arm.
findings.problem: The objective is win rate AND EV per trade jointly, and sl-5pct's screen_ev=0.022 is below control's screen_ev=0.029 on the same screen. Headlining the +5.26pp win-rate delta without the EV shortfall reports only the half of the objective that improved, on n=1540 of backfill rather than live evidence.
